title: Mask Adoption Behavioral Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and sustain mask-wearing behavior over time under social influence, information campaigns, market availability, and policy enforcement.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other's beliefs and adoption via their social network ties; opinions and observed behaviors shift adoption propensity.

interactions.name: contact_event
interactions.description: Co-location at a site produces contact events; if disease dynamics are modeled, mask use reduces transmission probabilities.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to price, stock, and rationing constraints.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities or locations check compliance and apply warnings/fines; individuals update compliance based on enforcement experiences.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast pro- or anti-mask messages; individuals update beliefs based on message credibility and reach.

interactions.name: household_sharing
interactions.description: Households share information and mask inventory; intra-household norms shape adoption.

interactions.name: policy_setting
interactions.description: Policy authority sets or updates mask mandates/recommendations for locations based on monitored indicators.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mask adoption fraction at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until at least 50% of the population adopts mask wearing.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the last N days (e.g., last 30 days).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality
metrics.description: Variation or Gini-like measure of adoption across demographic groups or locations.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement interventions (warnings/fines) applied.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days when retailer stock falls below a defined threshold.

metrics.name: price_volatility
metrics.description: Standard deviation of mask prices over time, reflecting market pressure.

metrics.name: Rt_reduction
metrics.description: Estimated reduction in effective reproduction number (if disease dynamics enabled) attributable to mask adoption.

metrics.name: cases_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections compared to a no-mask baseline (if disease dynamics enabled).

metrics.name: campaign_roi
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to campaigns divided by campaign cost.
